field_evidence.dataset_statement: LFB publishes identified bariatric special-service incidents from January 2009; records include location information at postcode sector, borough and ward level and incident year.
field_evidence.resource_name: Bariatric incidents attended by LFB from Jan 2009.csv

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade 'Bariatric incidents attended by LFB' dataset. The current resource spans January 2009 through July 2026 and supplies incident location information at postcode-sector, borough and ward level. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity to that unused public-safety source window without claiming an extracted Campden incident row, geometry, parcel join or parcel progress.
